What\'s in the file

Included: sound settings and EQ presets, app profiles, automations and the quick settings tile, the headset shortcut, call settings, your headsets\' saved choices (such as Headphone type), the Sleep tab\'s timer, alarms and mixes, and the app\'s look.

Not included: Bluetooth pairings and links (on a new phone you pair and link your headsets again), the Bluetooth history, demo mode, and permissions, which you allow again. Lab scans, and voice memos on Android 9, sit in Earshot\'s own folder and are deleted with the app: copy them out first if you want to keep them.
Nothing leaves your phone except the file you save. Earshot has no internet access. The file isn\'t encrypted, so keep it somewhere you trust.

The older Earshot is still on this phone. If it\'s version 0.9.1 or later, open More, Back up and restore in it, save your settings, and import that file here. Older versions don\'t have Back up and restore: set things up again here instead. When you\'re done, remove the old app so the two don\'t compete for your headset.
